user.title: Add Pilot Wire Thermostat
user.description:
Create a climate entity that controls a pilot wire module. 

 Once configured, the climate entity will appear in the Helpers tab. It will be automatically linked to the device of the select entity you chose during setup.

data_description.select: Select entity used to control the presets.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Temperature sensor that reflects the current temperature.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Humidity sensor that reflects the current humidity.
data_description.power_sensor: Power sensor used to monitor heater activity.
data_description.power_threshold: Power threshold above which the heater is considered to be heating.
data_description.default_preset: Preset used to turn on a thermostat that has no previous preset to go back to.

error.select_in_use: Another pilot wire thermostat already uses this select.
error.not_pilot_wire: The select has no pilot wire option, or is not available.
error.default_preset_not_offered: The default preset must be one the thermostat offers: turn on the additional modes, or pick another default preset.
error.default_preset_missing: The select has no option for the default preset.
